skill.name: treatment-plans
skill.description: Create concise clinical treatment plans using LaTeX templates, SMART goals, monitoring sections, safety guidance, and specialty-specific examples for healthcare documentation.
skill.summary: Build structured medical treatment plans with templates, goals, timelines, and validation checks.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from clinical language, Markdown backticks, LaTeX snippets, or dictionary key terminology. Confirmed risks are limited to privileged TeX install commands and helper scripts that can write or copy files to caller-selected paths. No prompt injection, credential harvesting, or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Privileged TeX installation commands appear in user-facing instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Remove sudo-based install examples or require explicit human approval before any system-wide package or texmf changes.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts can write or copy files to arbitrary user-selected output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize output paths, constrain writes to the workspace or an output directory, and avoid overwriting existing files by default.

content.value_statement: Clinical teams need concise care plans that are structured, measurable, and easy to review. This skill provides templates, goal frameworks, validation scripts, and checklist guidance for treatment plans.
actual_capabilities: Provides LaTeX templates for general medical, rehabilitation, mental health, chronic disease, perioperative, and pain management plans.
Supports one-page, standard, and extended treatment plan formats.
Includes SMART goal guidance, monitoring schedules, and outcome sections.
Provides scripts for template generation, completeness checks, timelines, and plan validation.
Includes professional styling guidance for PDF-ready medical documents.
Includes regulatory, safety, and specialty reference material for plan review.
limitations: Does not replace licensed clinical judgment or local medical policy.
Requires users to de-identify patient information before use.
PDF generation depends on local LaTeX packages and system setup.
Helper scripts can write files and should run in a controlled workspace.

use_cases.title: Draft Clinic Care Plans
use_cases.description: Create concise medical treatment plans with goals, interventions, monitoring steps, and follow-up schedules.

use_cases.title: Structure Rehabilitation Programs
use_cases.description: Prepare therapy plans with functional goals, milestone timelines, patient education, and progress measures.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Complex Care
use_cases.description: Organize chronic disease or perioperative plans across medications, safety checks, referrals, and review dates.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a concise treatment plan draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-page treatment plan for a de-identified adult patient with [condition]. Include goals, interventions, monitoring, and follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Add SMART Goals
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on measurable outcomes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft SMART short-term and long-term goals for [condition]. Include patient priorities, measurable targets, timelines, and monitoring measures.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Specialty Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a specialty workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [rehabilitation, mental health, chronic disease, perioperative, or pain] treatment plan using the matching template and safety checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and Refine
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this treatment plan for completeness, SMART goals, safety risks, monitoring gaps, and concise clinical language. Suggest focused revisions.

output_examples.input: A clinician needs a concise plan for type 2 diabetes follow-up.
output_examples.output: A structured care plan with diagnosis, SMART goals, medication actions, monitoring intervals, patient education, and follow-up dates.

output_examples.input: A therapist needs a rehabilitation plan after knee surgery.
output_examples.output: A phase-based therapy plan with mobility goals, exercise progression, safety limits, milestones, and reassessment checkpoints.

output_examples.input: A reviewer needs to check a draft plan before export.
output_examples.output: A focused quality review covering missing sections, unclear goals, safety gaps, timeline issues, and documentation improvements.

best_practices: Use de-identified patient details and avoid protected health information.
Confirm all clinical recommendations against current local guidelines.
Run validation checks before sharing or converting the plan to PDF.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a substitute for licensed clinical review.
Do not include real patient identifiers in prompts or generated files.
Do not run privileged install commands without explicit human approval.

faq.question: Can this skill create different treatment plan types?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates for general medical, rehabilitation, mental health, chronic disease, perioperative, and pain management plans.

faq.question: Does it generate PDF documents?
faq.answer: It provides LaTeX templates and compile guidance. PDF output depends on a working local LaTeX installation.

faq.question: Is it safe for real patient data?
faq.answer: Use de-identified information only. Users remain responsible for privacy, consent, and compliance with local requirements.

faq.question: Can it validate treatment plan quality?
faq.answer: Yes. Included scripts and checklists support completeness checks, SMART goal review, timeline review, and safety review.

faq.question: Does it provide medical advice?
faq.answer: It helps draft documentation. A licensed clinician must verify diagnoses, treatments, doses, and monitoring decisions.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
